author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Headers and footers in Microsoft Word can completely transform the look and professionalism of your documents, but many people only use a fraction of what’s possible. In this complete Microsoft Word tutorial, you’ll learn everything you need to know about headers and footers, from the basics all the way to advanced formatting techniques.

In this video, you’ll learn how to:
• Understand what headers and footers are in Microsoft Word
• Open and edit headers and footers
• Add and format text in headers and footers
• Insert and customize page numbers
• Use Different First Page settings
• Create different odd and even page headers
• Set unique headers and footers for different sections
• Insert images and company logos into headers
• Adjust header and footer margin settings

Whether you’re creating reports, resumes, business documents, school papers, proposals, or branded company templates, mastering headers and footers will help your documents look polished and organized.
